text.hi: between = दो के बीच में; among = कई के बीच में; into = अंदर की ओर; across = आर-पार; up = ऊपर।
text.hinglish: between = do ke beech mein; among = kai ke beech mein; into = andar ki or; across = aar-paar; up = upar.
text.en: between = in the middle of two; among = in the middle of many; into = going inside; across = from one side to the other; up = higher.

text.hi: अब बातचीत को indirect speech में बदलो। किताब का उदाहरण: Rani: Seema, where did you go last Sunday? → Rani asked Seema where she had gone last Sunday। (did go → had gone, yesterday → the day before, today → that day, will → would)
text.hinglish: Ab baatcheet ko indirect speech mein badlo. Kitaab ka udaharan: Rani: Seema, where did you go last Sunday? → Rani asked Seema where she had gone last Sunday. (did go → had gone, yesterday → the day before, today → that day, will → would)
text.en: Now change the conversation into indirect speech. The book's example: Rani: Seema, where did you go last Sunday? → Rani asked Seema where she had gone last Sunday. (did go → had gone, yesterday → the day before, today → that day, will → would)

prompt.hi: बदलो: Bala: Vinita, where did you go yesterday?
prompt.hinglish: Badlo: Bala: Vinita, where did you go yesterday?
prompt.en: Change: Bala: Vinita, where did you go yesterday?

steps.answer: Bala asked Vinita where she had gone the day before.
